items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends users update their installations to the newest version.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extension
items.summary: Sansec reported a critical vulnerability in one of 25 Amasty extensions that could lead to remote code execution. Merchants using Amasty extensions should apply the latest security releases.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: This flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. This vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
items.summary: This denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce stems from a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component. It can be triggered remotely without authentication, causing the application to crash.

items.title: jQuery-UI Library Security Vulnerability
items.summary: A known security vulnerability in jQuery-UI library version 1.13.1 affects multiple versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. A hotfix is available for affected deployments.

items.title: Require.js Library Security Vulnerability
items.summary: A security vulnerability was reported in Require.js 2.3.6, leading to an upgrade to version 2.3.7 in Adobe Commerce. This fix was included in October 2024 security patches for various release lines.
